text_5b0466f99b8d: Open as a work report proposal
text_5c1c93ed3826: Use planned data as a proposal
text_0e5619923a68: Review the plan. Only your selected data is applied. No report is sent. Enter the train number and adjust the proposals to the actual duty.
text_5cd750b403a3: Prepare a new work report draft
text_1b2e9cf12694: Add a journey draft: stations, planned times and rotation name
text_8dbd9458ced8: Finish any active GPS recording and save changes to the synchronized report before applying planned data.
text_cfe3bd6b67cc: Choose available planned data and an editable draft. Check duty bounds and the rotation name (up to 200 characters).
text_e4cbebe9734c: Planned data applied as a proposal. Enter the train number and check all times before saving or synchronizing.
text_045c329d1843: Your confirmed selection replaces duty times in the current draft. Existing journeys are retained; the proposed journey is added.
text_efeaf6a3291f: This planned journey is already in the draft.
text_5f28db9a6f5d: The roster shows duty start/end as DD.MM.YY-HH:MM and planned departure/arrival as HH:MM. Open it from the work report and select a row. Review the proposals and choose duty times, an additional journey, and the current or a new draft. Only confirmation fills the draft. Existing journeys remain; creating a new draft first preserves the previous one locally. Enter the train number yourself. The optional rotation name sits beside the train number and is retained when saving and synchronizing. Active GPS recording or unsaved changes to a synchronized report blocks applying proposals. Cancel changes nothing.
